x: Charlie Stirling and Roy Woodhead are also jumpers of promise. Charlie Melchoir and George Powell have again shown up well in the Javelin, and lent valuable assistance in the Shot and Discus events.
Roy Woodhead having completed his initial training as a "foot-slogger" has now settled down in Salop for a period of more intensive training.
Roy Woodhead wishes to be remembered to the boys and even in the Shetland Isles, where as a lance jack he is on a 12-week signal course, finds time to pursue entertainment, official and unofficial.
